rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a computer hard drive or hard disk.

example.english: The computer's hard drive has broken, so none of the photos on it can be read.
example.traditional: 部電腦嘅硬碟壞咗，入面啲相片全部都讀唔到。
